name: flutter-probe
description: End-to-end testing for Flutter apps. Manage devices, author and run ProbeScript tests, capture screenshots, generate reports — directly from Claude Desktop.
long_description:
FlutterProbe is a high-performance E2E testing framework for Flutter mobile apps. This extension exposes 31 tools to Claude:

- **Device lifecycle** — list, start, and shut down iOS simulators and Android emulators.
- **Test authoring** — read and write `.probe` files, dump the live widget tree, take screenshots.
- **Execution** — run tests on a single device, in parallel, or as multi-device composite tests.
- **Reporting** — read JSON results, generate HTML reports.
- **Performance** — trends and baseline comparisons of measured CPU, memory, frames and network.
- **Probe Studio** — drive a running Studio (started with PROBE_STUDIO_AUTOMATION=1): open a workspace, connect, run a file, read step-by-step progress.
- **Performance** — trends and baseline comparisons of measured CPU, memory, frames and network.
- **Probe Studio** — drive a running Studio (started with PROBE_STUDIO_AUTOMATION=1): open a workspace, connect, run a file, read step-by-step progress.
- **Project management** — initialize a new project, record interactions, AI-generate tests from a prompt.

After install, Claude can read your widget tree and write tests that target real selectors — no manual JSON config or PATH setup required.

projectRoot.title: Flutter project directory
projectRoot.description: Path to the Flutter app you want to test. Should contain probe.yaml and a tests/ folder. Tools like run_tests and get_report resolve paths against this directory.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List all connected/booted simulators, emulators, and physical devices.

tools.name: list_simulators
tools.description: List all iOS simulators (booted AND shutdown).

tools.name: list_avds
tools.description: List Android Virtual Device (AVD) names available on the host.

tools.name: start_device
tools.description: Boot an Android emulator (by AVD name) or iOS simulator (by UDID).

tools.name: shutdown_device
tools.description: Shut down an iOS simulator (provide udid) or an Android emulator (provide serial).

tools.name: get_widget_tree
tools.description: Dump the live widget tree from the running Flutter app.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current screen of the running Flutter app and return the image.

tools.name: read_test
tools.description: Read the contents of a .probe test file.

tools.name: write_test
tools.description: Create or overwrite a .probe test file.

tools.name: run_script
tools.description: Execute an ad-hoc inline ProbeScript without creating a file.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run FlutterProbe .probe test files against the connected Flutter app.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List all .probe test files in a directory.

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Validate .probe files for syntax errors without running them against a device.

tools.name: migrate_maestro
tools.description: Convert Maestro YAML flows to ProbeScript .probe files.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Read the most recently modified JSON test run report.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Generate a standalone HTML test report from a JSON results file.

tools.name: generate_test
tools.description: Use AI to generate a .probe test file from a natural language description.

tools.name: triage_failure
tools.description: OPTIONAL and advisory: explain the failed tests in a JSON results file using the AI model configured in probe.yaml (ai: block — a local OpenAI-compatible model such as...

tools.name: system_dialog
tools.description: Inspect and answer OS-level system dialogs that live outside the Flutter app and are invisible to get_widget_tree: iOS permission alerts, the StoreKit "Sign in to Appl...

tools.name: perf_trend
tools.description: Show how a measured performance number changed over past runs (from reports/perf-history.jsonl, written by probe test whenever a test uses start measuring ...

tools.name: perf_compare
tools.description: Compare two performance baseline files (written by probe test --perf-baseline FILE --perf-update-baseline) and list every measurement that got worse by more than the t...

tools.name: init_project
tools.description: Initialize a new FlutterProbe project in the current working directory.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check that this project and machine are ready for probe test; returns a JSON report. Changes nothing.

tools.name: validate_project
tools.description: Check probe.yaml and the probe_version pin without connecting to a device; returns a JSON report.

tools.name: record
tools.description: Record user interactions with the running Flutter app and generate a .probe test file.

tools.name: studio_open_workspace
tools.description: Open a folder as the workspace of a running Probe Studio (the one started with PROBE_STUDIO_AUTOMATION=1) and list it.

tools.name: studio_list_devices
tools.description: List the simulators/emulators Studio can connect to (booted/online ones), as Studio's device picker shows them.

tools.name: studio_connect
tools.description: Connect Studio to a device (id from studio_list_devices), or to a phone on the network with host, port and token (profile build with PROBE_AGENT=true and PROBE_WIFI=true); test_only=true only checks reachability.

tools.name: studio_run_file
tools.description: Start running a .probe file in Studio.

tools.name: studio_cancel
tools.description: Cancel the run Studio is executing.

tools.name: studio_run_state

tools.name: studio_results
tools.description: The test results of the current or last run in Studio (name, passed, error, duration, performance measurements), plus whether the run is still going.

tools.name: studio_screenshot
tools.description: A screenshot of the device Studio is connected to (what Studio shows in its device view).

tools.name: studio_widget_tree
tools.description: The widget tree of the app on the device Studio is connected to, as text (read-only).

tools.name: studio_ui_state
tools.description: The connection and run state Studio shows right now, in one read-only call.
